_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_as_of: 2026-06-25 (Session 73 · CPL Assistant response-logic tuning — live on cpl-chat v17)
_status: SESSION 73 — the CPL Assistant ('Sierra', going forward) just got three response-logic tweaks you asked for, now LIVE on both the dashboard tab AND the production map.rccd.edu widget (they share one backend): (1) it no longer says a STATEWIDE credit lives at one college — statewide recommendations are system-wide and you access them through YOUR OWN college's landing page; (2) instead of '6 credit recommendations' it now LISTS the actual course titles + units you'd be eligible for; (3) for a broad question that matches lots of colleges it first ASKS 'any particular part of California, or want to see them all?' before dumping the list. Earlier this session: the broken college landing-page links are fixed + auto-refreshing from the MAP API. Give all of it a spin and tell me what to refine next. NEXT (Fable): the CPL-Assistant CCR/CER recommender ETL is the big build; the M-ID renumber re-mint + TMC acceptance engine lanes still stand.

items.text: NEW: the CPL Assistant has three improvements live now — try a few questions and tell me what to tune. (1) Ask about a STATEWIDE credit (e.g. a statewide RE or firefighter recommendation): it should say it's available system-wide and point you to YOUR college's landing page, not to one specific college. (2) Ask 'what credit can I get for an EMT license?': it should LIST the eligible course titles + units, not just a number. (3) Ask a broad 'which colleges give credit for X' question: it should ASK whether you want a specific region or all options before showing a long list, then refine when you answer (e.g. 'Southern California').

Also fixed this session: the assistant's college CPL landing-page links were broken/stale (San Diego Miramar was pointing at the wrong code). They're now synced from the MAP College Landing Page API and auto-refresh weekly, so they should match map.rccd.edu/cpllandingpages. Click a couple from a college-specific answer and flag any that still misfire.

Carry-over: in the ✨ Suggested-merges / ⚇ Merge sidebar, each candidate shows a Beg / Int / Adv level chip (classified by Title-5 §55050). Explicit ranges + words/ordinals are reliable; a bare single number ('Spanish 3') is just a hint you can override. Eyeball a language or ESL family and correct any level that reads wrong.

Carry-over: the worklist groups WORD VARIANTS — 'Conversational Japanese' ↔ 'Japanese Conversation', 'Assisting' ↔ 'Assistant'. Confirm the clean language-conversation families when you get a chance. Where a group shows an amber '⚠ Spans N disciplines' note, eyeball it for homonyms (music vs office 'keyboard') before confirming.
Standing bonus: we'll keep adding Arroyo-Seco-style California plein-air landscapes (Redmond, Guy Rose, Wendt, Payne) to First Light — flag any artist/work you'd love and we'll source it.

CPL-Assistant CCR/CER-grounded recommender ETL (green-lit, the big next build): build the CCR/CER/adoption-leverage ETL into shared Supabase so the Assistant can recommend the likely local course + credit rec, grounded in real course-identity data. Scope: docs/kb-notes/cpl-assistant-ccr-cer-recommendation-scope.md. The v17 multi-turn plumbing is the foundation. Sierra rename lands with the Student Portal, not piecemeal.

When the merge wave settles (NOT per-merge): the unverified-M-ID renumber re-mint — close gaps + re-sort 001,002… by title within each (canonical SUBJ4, band). Full Rule-7, unverified-only, ONE pass. Scope: docs/unverified_mid_renumber_scope.md. Dry-run first, Sam's go before apply + Supabase re-key.

TMC Phase-2 ACCEPTANCE ENGINE in tmc_builder.js (Sam: 'Go for A'): per-slot verdict from the ASCCC rules (C-ID match = ✓ · slot.flexible = ⚠ accept-with-ASSIST · specific C-ID filled by a non-match = faculty review · unfilled = ○) + structural checklist + a Ready/N-issues banner. Consume slot.flexible + t.flexibility (#479). Scope: docs/kb-notes/tmc-co-review-scope.md.
